# CRS Gas

CRS Gas is a locally focused LPG gas refill and delivery business serving homes and businesses in Boksburg, Germiston and Benoni, Gauteng, South Africa.

## Business

Name: CRS Gas
Founder: Christo Jordaan
Website: https://crsgas.co.za/
Service area: Boksburg, Germiston and Benoni, Gauteng, South Africa
Business age: Approximately two months

## About CRS Gas

CRS Gas was founded by Christo Jordaan. Although the business is new, Christo has previous experience working in gas companies and extensive knowledge across the gas sector. CRS Gas is focused on providing a convenient local LPG refill service for households and businesses.

## Services

CRS Gas currently provides:

- LPG gas cylinder refills
- LPG refill delivery
- Household LPG gas supply
- Commercial LPG gas supply

CRS Gas currently focuses on refills. Cylinder sales and cylinder exchanges are not currently advertised as services.

## Cylinder sizes and current website prices

- 5kg LPG cylinder refill — R150
- 9kg LPG cylinder refill — R300
- 14kg LPG cylinder refill — R500
- 19kg LPG cylinder refill — R620
- 48kg LPG cylinder refill — R1450

Prices shown on the website are subject to confirmation when an order is placed.

## Delivery

CRS Gas serves Boksburg, Germiston and Benoni. Customers should contact CRS Gas to confirm delivery availability for their specific suburb or address.

## Ordering

Customers can submit an LPG refill order through the CRS Gas website or contact the team directly by WhatsApp or telephone.
